effects: Claims the reward owner's airdrop share for every unclaimed month from the owner's next claimable month up to and including _month, not only _month.
Sends the total claimed amount to _recipient: as native FLR when _wrap is false, or as WFLR through wNat.depositTo when _wrap is true.
Marks every month up to _month as claimed for the reward owner (ownerNextClaimableMonth = _month + 1), so the owner cannot claim those months again.
If the signer is not the reward owner, the signer acts as an approved executor, and ClaimSetupManager restricts the allowed recipients.
The amount comes from storage (vote power at random blocks times the unclaimed pool), not from calldata. The function is nonpayable.
formats.shown: The intent 'claim rewards' with the reward owner, the recipient, a raw month number and a raw 'Wrap' true/false.

findings.title: claim labels _month as 'Month', but the call claims every unclaimed month up to it.
findings.evidence: DistributionToDelegators._claim: `for (uint256 month = _nextClaimableMonth(_rewardOwner, _monthToExpireNext); month <= _month; month++)`. NatSpec: `@param _month last month to claim for`. Descriptor: label 'Month', format raw. Cases 0 and 3 show 'Month: 12'.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Claim up to month' (or 'Last month claimed').

findings.title: claim shows the received asset only as a raw 'Wrap: true/false' flag, not as WFLR versus FLR.
findings.evidence: _transferOrWrap: `if (_wrap) { wNat.depositTo{value: _rewardAmount}(_recipient); } else { _recipient.call{value: _rewardAmount}("") }`. Descriptor: `"label": "Wrap", "format": "raw"`. Case 0 shows 'Wrap: true' and case 3 shows 'Wrap: false'.
findings.fix: Use an enum or map for _wrap, e.g. true → 'As WFLR (wrapped)' and false → 'As native FLR', with the label 'Receive as'.

findings.title: claim has no interpolated intent naming the recipient, and the intent does not say FLR airdrop.
findings.evidence: Descriptor: `"intent": "claim rewards"`, with no interpolatedIntent. The recipient of the claimed FLR is the _recipient field, which can differ from the reward owner.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Claim FLR airdrop of {_rewardOwner} to {_recipient}'. Change the intent to 'Claim FLR airdrop'.

findings.title: claim cannot show the claimed amount, because the contract computes it from storage and vote power.
findings.evidence: _getClaimableWei: `return (_weight, unclaimedAmount.mulDiv(_weight, unclaimedWeight));`, which uses combinedNat.balanceOfAt at the random vote power blocks.

effects: For each listed reward owner, claims the owner's airdrop share (unless the owner opted out) and the share of the owner's personal delegation account, for all unclaimed months up to _month.
Sends each owner's claimed total minus the executor fee to the claim address (the personal delegation account if enabled, else the owner), always wrapped as WFLR.
Pays the executor fee times the number of owners to msg.sender (the signer) in native FLR.
Marks months up to _month as claimed for each owner and each delegation account.
ClaimSetupManager supplies the claim addresses and the fee from storage. The function is nonpayable.
formats.shown: The intent 'batch claims rewards', the list of reward owners and a raw month number.

findings.title: autoClaim does not say that it deducts an executor fee per owner and pays it to the caller.
findings.evidence: autoClaim: `rewardAmount = rewardAmount.sub(executorFeeValue, ERR_CLAIMED_AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL);` and `_transferOrWrap(msg.sender, executorFeeValue.mul(_rewardOwners.length), false);`. Descriptor intent: 'batch claims rewards'. Case 1 shows only 'Reward Owner' and 'Month: 12'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Claim FLR airdrop as WFLR, executor fee paid' or add an interpolatedIntent that states the fee goes to the caller.

findings.title: autoClaim does not say that rewards arrive as WFLR at the owner's delegation account.
findings.evidence: autoClaim: `_transferOrWrap(claimAddress, rewardAmount, true);` where claimAddress comes from claimSetupManager.getAutoClaimAddressesAndExecutorFee. Descriptor: `"intent": "batch claims rewards"` and no recipient field.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Claim FLR airdrop as WFLR' and add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Claim WFLR airdrop for {_rewardOwners} up to month {_month}'.

findings.title: autoClaim labels _month as 'Month', but it claims every unclaimed month up to it.
findings.evidence: _claim loops `month <= _month`. NatSpec: `@param _month last month to claim for`. Descriptor: label 'Month', format raw.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Claim up to month'.

findings.title: autoClaim gets its recipients and fee from ClaimSetupManager storage, which no descriptor can show.

effects: Only governance can call it. In production mode, the call only records a timelocked governance call (_recordTimelockedCall) and the change happens later through executeGovernanceCall.
When it executes, it permanently marks each listed address as opted out (optOut = true) and adds it to optOutAddresses. Each address must already have requested the opt-out.
Opted-out addresses can never claim the airdrop again (claim reverts with 'already opted out'), and their weight leaves future distributions.
No asset moves. The function is nonpayable.
formats.shown: The intent 'opt out of airdrop' and the list of 'Opt Out Address' entries.

findings.title: confirmOptOutOfAirdrop reads like the signer opting out, but it is a governance confirmation for other addresses.
findings.evidence: DistributionToDelegators.confirmOptOutOfAirdrop is `onlyGovernance` and requires `optOutCandidate[optOutAddress]`. The user's own opt-out is optOutOfAirdrop(). Descriptor: `"intent": "opt out of airdrop"`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Confirm airdrop opt-out (governance)' and add an interpolatedIntent 'Permanently opt out {_optOutAddresses} from airdrop'.

findings.title: confirmOptOutOfAirdrop does not say that the opt-out is permanent or that production mode timelocks it.
findings.evidence: GovernedBase.onlyGovernance: `if (executing || !productionMode) { ... _; } else { _recordTimelockedCall(msg.data); }`. Nothing in the contract resets optOut[...] = true. Descriptor intent: 'opt out of airdrop'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Schedule permanent airdrop opt-out'.

findings.title: confirmOptOutOfAirdrop is onlyGovernance, so only the governance account can sign it.
findings.evidence: `function confirmOptOutOfAirdrop(address[] calldata _optOutAddresses) external onlyGovernance`. The user-facing optOutOfAirdrop() has no format in the descriptor.
findings.fix: Add a format for optOutOfAirdrop() with the intent 'Request airdrop opt-out' if the ABI includes it.

couldNotCheck: ClaimSetupManager (getAutoClaimAddressesAndExecutorFee, checkExecutorAndAllowedRecipient) is not in the directory. It decides the recipients and the executor fee in autoClaim, and the allowed recipients for an executor in claim.
